title: dryopteris saxifragivaria
intro: Dryopteris saxifragivaria, commonly known as saxifrage fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the Dryopteris genus. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of saxifrage fern include its ability to calm the nervous system, relieve muscle spasms, and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of saxifrage fern include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
